parsed.note_claim: The 13,099 figure represents non-citizens with homicide convictions on the non-detained docket as of July 2024, covering decades rather than just 2024.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: They show that, as of July 2024, there were 425,431 non-citizens with criminal convictions on ICE's "non-detained docket"... Of these: 13,099 were convicted of homicide
parsed.reason: The article confirms the 13,099 figure comes from the July 2024 non-detained docket, covers convictions over many years, and includes individuals in prison under other agencies.
